methodology: Same model, root, condition, alert, chain and prompt template. Applicability and trigger are explicit in both contexts. Pair order alternates; seeded skill order avoids always placing the valid candidate first. Distractors are synthetic, unrelated and never executable. No remediation. Risk-ranked policy tests admissibility, not optimal remediation or LLM benefit.
